title: pithecellobium lanceolatum
intro: Pithecellobium lanceolatum, commonly known as the Guanacaste tree, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. It is a large tree with a broad canopy and a straight trunk, native to Central America. The Guanacaste tree has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pithecellobium lanceolatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to have antioxidant, antispasmodic, and antifungal activities.
